description: Use this skill when user requests to execute or implement a Crossplane v2 migration plan. Executes the migration plan generated by plan-v2-migration stage by stage, updating each function's tests to v2 before migrating the function. Use immediately when user says "execute the migration", "implement the v2 migration", "run the migration plan", or "continue the migration". Use this skill instead of manually executing migration steps. This skill reads .agents/plans/CROSSPLANE_V2_MIGRATION.md and executes it, editing YAML directly and handing functions, tests and verification to author-composition, author-tests, verify-configuration and e2e-test-configuration. Not for analyzing a project or writing the plan - use plan-v2-migration.
